blocked_until_later_phases: Training promotion requires backend-like candidate sets with relevance labels or approved weak labels.
Production matchLevel and matchScore semantics require calibration evidence.
Backend response validator must enforce candidate membership, uniqueness, score range, and max item constraints.
Wrapper copy for reasons and next steps must remain grounded in rankingSignals, matchedSkills, and missingSkills.

hard_fail_checks.failure_action: Return validation error to backend; do not fallback to static artifact jobs.
hard_fail_checks.rule: If rankingPolicy.requireCandidateJobIds is true, jobCandidates must be present before scoring.

hard_fail_checks.failure_action: Reject output and log contract violation.
hard_fail_checks.rule: set(output.jobId) must be subset of set(input.jobCandidates.jobId).

hard_fail_checks.failure_action: Reject output or deterministic dedupe before backend response, depending on serving policy.
hard_fail_checks.rule: Each output jobId appears at most once.

hard_fail_checks.failure_action: Reject invalid row or whole response; do not clamp silently in production.
hard_fail_checks.rule: Every matchScore is integer 0-100 and finite before serialization.

hard_fail_checks.failure_action: Trim only after sorting if policy allows; otherwise reject.
hard_fail_checks.rule: Output count must not exceed rankingPolicy.maxRecommendations or public API cap.

disallowed_inputs: static full job_index ranking output as final recommendations
inactive job ids not supplied by backend
backend hydration fields not needed for scoring
bookmarked/applied flags as ranking features unless explicit product policy approves them
manual validation labels or target relevance as inference-time features

backend_owns: candidate retrieval from live backend data
deduplication policy before model call when configured
job detail hydration after model output
model_owns: emit grounded skill and ranking signals from candidate evidence

required_payload_fields.rule: Required trace id; never used as predictive feature.
Must identify candidate reranking input schema version, e.g. job-recommendations-v1.
Backend-prepared normalized profile/CV/preference evidence only; no frontend-trusted raw profile object.
Backend-supplied limits and constraints; model must obey maxRecommendations, requireCandidateJobIds, and deduplicateByJobId.
Required backend candidate set. Empty set returns empty recommendations with model metadata, not static artifact jobs.

training_dataset_requirements: candidate_set_id groups each candidate list for one profile/CV request
candidate_relevance_label or weak relevance label exists for evaluation
split isolation prevents same profile request leaking across train/validation/test
candidate generation source and timestamp are recorded for stale-candidate diagnostics

model_owned_fields.rule: Must equal one supplied jobCandidates[].jobId; null is not allowed in model-core reranking output.
Rounded, bounded score from ranking/scoring model; production semantics wait for calibration evidence.
Derived from calibrated score bands after calibration; before calibration use prototype thresholds only in reports.
Intersection of normalized candidate skills and job required skills; no invented or proficiency-inferred skills.
Required job skills absent from normalized candidate evidence; exclude optional skills unless policy marks them required.
Stable explainability keys only; wrapper may convert to prose.
Optional model-safe suggestions grounded in missingSkills/rankingSignals; wrapper may own final copy.

recommendations_shape.ordering: descending matchScore with deterministic tie break by input order or stable jobId

wrapper_owned_fields: single nextStep string for CV Analyzer public response

current_readiness_decision.reason: Recommendation ranking must wait for backend candidate-set labels or realistic candidate sets.

required_metrics.purpose: Measure top-five ordering quality for public CV Analyzer cap.
Measure broader candidate ordering before public cap or standalone internal response.
Measure precision of relevant jobs in top ten when relevance is binary or thresholded.
Prove ranking never invents or duplicates jobs.

model_must_not_do: hydrate stale job details from training artifacts
decide whether inactive/private jobs may be shown
override backend deduplication or visibility rules
